gates.name: Mechanical Integrity
gates.description: Ensures working directory state and atomic change scope.
requirements: Clean working tree for post-commit validation
Declared scope alignment for pre-commit validation

gates.name: Build Integrity
gates.description: Ensures compilation of all system tiers.
requirements: Zero blocking compiler errors or warnings

gates.name: Orchestration Topology
gates.description: Enforces architectural service mesh and project relationships.
requirements: Existence of core projects: Aspire.AppHost, RPAS.Governance.Api, RPAS.Governance.Core, RPAS.Governance.Persistence
AppHost references and orchestrates Api, ServiceDefaults, and PostgreSQL persistence

gates.name: Governance Attestation
gates.description: Validation of TAR-COL invariants and human accountability.
requirements: Enforcement of G1–G6 invariants and append-only ledger integrity
All mutations attributed to authorized decisions or petitioners

gates.name: Semantic Integrity
gates.description: Ensures intent alignment and prevents semantic drift.
requirements: Proof-of-life verification across all test suites

guardrails.G1_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY: AI proposes, Human approves, Orchestrator executes. No direct state mutation.
guardrails.G2_LIFECYCLE_INTEGRITY: All state transitions must follow the ritual chain: Ideation -> Business Case -> Approval -> Seed -> Proposal -> Decision -> Execution -> Verification.
guardrails.G3_EVIDENCE_LINEAGE: All artifacts must reference their governing decision and retain an immutable, append-only hash-chained audit trail.
guardrails.G4_DETERMINISM: Execution must be idempotent, replay-safe, and deterministic. Replays cannot corrupt state.
guardrails.G5_READ_VS_ACT: Experience Tier and external clients cannot mutate state outside explicit rituals; research tier is read-only.
guardrails.G6_TOPOLOGY_BOUNDARY: A mutation's target path must fall within the authority token's declared path envelope on segment boundaries.
